title: Make the failed-acknowledgement Candidate recovery control discriminate an attempted recovery
outcome: The existing request-boundary failed-acknowledgement regression distinguishes attempted-and-refused Candidate recovery from merely skipping recovery and returning InFlight, without changing product authority or adding a proof campaign.
acceptance: The existing unconfirmed-Candidate request test detects omission of request-side recovery by asserting its specific recovery failure or an existing appropriate recovery-attempt boundary, while retaining no-evaluator and same-Candidate custody assertions.
